title: Arrange act assert
summary: Arrange prepares input. Act runs the code. Assert checks the result. These three steps make a test easy to read.
introduction: Arrange prepares input. Act runs the code. Assert checks the result. These three steps make a test easy to read. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Arrange prepares input. Act runs the code. Assert checks the result. These three steps make a test easy to read.

blocks.code:
const input = 3; // arrange
const actual = input * input; // act
console.log(actual === 9); // assert
blocks.title: Arrange act assert

blocks.text: The result is true. The expected answer is written separately from the calculation.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Label the three steps in a test for adding two prices.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not calculate the expected result using the same buggy function you are testing.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
